title: Care Program Score Bands and Reassessment Calendar for Memory Care
content:
Under the Memory Care Residency Agreement the care program follows the score of the memory care assessment, a cognitive and functional assessment completed by a Larkspur memory care nurse. Scores are whole points. The figures below are the nursing department's standing values for each tier.

## Score bands

| Tier | Care program | Lowest score in the band | Highest score in the band |
|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | Essential | 0 | 40 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | Enhanced | 41 | 70 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | Essential | 0 | 40 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | Enhanced | 41 | 70 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | Advanced | 71 | 100 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | Advanced | 71 | 100 |

Both ends of a band belong to it: a score of 40 is essential and 41 is enhanced; 70 is enhanced and 71 is advanced. The suite type plays no part in the band - the essential band is 0 to 40 points whether the suite is companion or private.

## Reassessment and program notice calendar (calendar days)

| Tier | First reassessment completed within ... days of move-in | Maximum days between routine reassessments | Reassessment completed within ... days of return from a hospital stay | Written program notice issued within ... days of the assessment | Days after the written program notice before an increase found at a routine reassessment takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 30 | 90 | 3 | 2 | 30 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 30 | 90 | 3 | 2 | 30 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 30 | 90 | 3 | 2 | 30 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 30 | 90 | 3 | 2 | 30 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 30 | 60 | 3 | 2 | 30 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 30 | 60 | 3 | 2 | 30 |

## Notes on the calendar

- The routine interval is the only figure that differs between tiers: 90 days in the essential and enhanced programs, 60 days in the advanced program.
- The program notice column applies only where an assessment indicates a new care program; an assessment that confirms the current program has no program notice.
- The last column is a waiting period counted from the date the written program notice was issued.
